answer.why: TruBridge sells EHR software and revenue cycle management (RCM) services to community/rural hospitals and ambulatory clinics [T:P1.5, T:P1.7, T:P1.15]. CareCloud sells cloud-based EHR software, RCM, and practice management to medical practices/physician groups and hospitals [C:P1.2, C:P1.5, C:P1.12]. Both products (EHR + RCM) and customer types (healthcare providers including hospitals and ambulatory clinics) substantially overlap. TruBridge leans toward community/rural/critical access hospitals while CareCloud leans toward physician practices, but both explicitly serve hospitals and clinics. The revenue model (subscription + % of collections) and value chain position (software platform + outsourced service provider) are also closely aligned.

T:P1.1.text: TruBridge: RCM, EHR & Financial Solutions for Hospitals

T:P1.2.text: Healthcare Revenue Cycle & EHR Solutions That Drive Results

T:P1.3.text: From towns of 200 to cities of 200,000, TruBridge has the solutions your healthcare organization needs to stay independent and financially stable.

T:P1.4.text: Creating Stronger Communities Through Better Healthcare

T:P1.5.text: TruBridge helps rural hospitals, critical access hospitals, community hospitals, and clinics stay financially strong and achieve better financial, operational, and clinical outcomes. We offer technology and revenue cycle management services backed by more than 45 years of healthcare experience and trusted by multiple clients across the U.S.

T:P1.7.text: We deliver revenue cycle services, medical coding support, and EHR technology tailored to community-based healthcare organizations, ensuring operational strength so high-quality care can stay close to home. We combine proven healthcare technology with specialized support teams so you can improve productivity, strengthen revenue, and deliver better patient care.
